methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 home blood pressure monitors (upper-arm and wrist types): Omron Platinum BP5450, Omron Evolv BP7000, Omron 5 Series BP7250, Omron 10 Series BP7450, Withings BPM Connect, Withings BPM Core, QardioArm A100, Beurer BM67, A&D Medical UA-651BLE, Greater Goods 0604, iHealth Track KN-550BT, and Welch Allyn Home 1700 (H-BP100SBP). Primary sources were official manufacturer product pages (omronhealthcare.com, withings.com, ihealthlabs.com, medical.andonline.com, hillrom.com, shop.greatergoods.com) plus retailer and clinical validation databases (ValidateBP, MedGrade, Walmart, Amazon, Best Buy). Specs use inches for cuff range as stated by manufacturers; boolean true means the feature is present and documented; memory_readings counts on-device storage only (not unlimited cloud/app storage). All products re-verified 2026-06-19. Adversarial corrections this pass: Omron 5 Series BP7250 is single-user on-device (not two-user); Withings BPM Connect has NO irregular-heartbeat/arrhythmia detection (that capability belongs to BPM Core/Vision, not Connect); iHealth Track KN-550BT DOES have an irregular-heartbeat detector and uses a wide-range 22-48 cm cuff (not 22-42 cm); several retail prices refreshed to current published values. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Omron Platinum BP5450
products.priceNote: MSRP per MedGrade device listing; this model is largely superseded by the BP5465
products.provenance: Specs (200 readings for 2 users / 100 each, 9–17 in cuff, Bluetooth, irregular heartbeat indicator, FDA 510(k) cleared) verified via MedGrade and confirmed against the Amazon product title 'Stores Up To 200 Readings for Two Users (100 readings each)'. MSRP $84.00 from MedGrade; no release year found in any source consulted. BP5450 superseded by BP5465 which adds AFib screening.

products.name: Omron Evolv BP7000
products.priceNote: MSRP per Omron Healthcare official product page
products.provenance: MSRP $119.99 confirmed directly from the official Omron Healthcare page. Cuff 9–17 in, 100 on-device readings, single-user on-device (spec table lists two-user mode 'No'), Bluetooth with Omron Connect app, irregular heartbeat indicator (count up to 3). AHA/ESH validated and FDA 510(k) cleared. One-piece tubeless design. Release year not found in any source.

products.name: Omron 5 Series BP7250
products.priceNote: Typical current US retail (~$79.99 at Diabetic Warehouse / Walmart); Omron's own 5 Series page now lists the successor BP7255 at $83.99
products.provenance: CORRECTED: the BP7250 is a SINGLE-USER device on-device — Walmart's official product title reads 'Stores Up To 60 Readings for One User', and Diabetic Warehouse and Omron support both confirm '60 readings for one user' (unlimited users only via the Omron Connect app). Draft's user_profiles=2 was wrong; set to 1. 60 on-device readings, 9–17 in wide-range D-ring cuff, Bluetooth, enhanced irregular-heartbeat symbol confirmed. Omron's 5 Series product URL now redirects to the successor BP7255 (single user, 30 readings, $83.99); a retail price near $79.99 is found for the BP7250 but it is superseded. No clinical-validation statement on the consulted pages; left null.

products.name: Omron 10 Series BP7450
products.priceNote: Superseded by BP7465; retailer prices ~$99–110 but no current official MSRP from Omron for the BP7450
products.provenance: Specs confirmed: 200 total readings (100 per user), 2 users, 9–17 in Easy-Wrap ComFit cuff, Bluetooth with Omron Connect, irregular-heartbeat symbol (up to 3), TruRead. Omron now directs the 10 Series to the BP7465 (adds AFib screening); BP7450 superseded. No explicit clinical-validation statement on retailer pages; null used. No current Omron MSRP published for BP7450, so priceUsd null.

products.name: Withings BPM Connect
products.priceNote: MSRP per Withings US official product page (withings.com/us/en/bpm-connect)
products.provenance: CORRECTED: irregular_heartbeat_detection true→false. The standard BPM Connect has NO irregular-heartbeat / arrhythmia detection — Withings' own support material states 'the blood pressure monitor BPM Connect doesn't pick up irregularities in heart beat'; AFib/IHB belongs to BPM Core (ECG) and the newer BPM Vision, not Connect. The draft conflated Connect with Core. Price $129.95 confirmed from the official Withings US product page. Cuff 9–17 in (22–42 cm), up to 8 on-device measurements between syncs (unlimited cloud), Wi-Fi + Bluetooth via Health Mate app. FDA cleared / clinically validated (ANSI/AAMI/ISO 81060-2) per ValidateBP. On-device user-profile limit not stated; null. Release year not found.

products.name: Withings BPM Core
products.priceNote: US store shows 'Coming soon' as of 2026-06-19; no current published USD MSRP. EU price ~€249.95
products.provenance: Specs verified: cuff 9–17 in (22–42 cm), up to 8 on-device measurements, up to 8 users, Wi-Fi + Bluetooth, ECG with AFib detection (irregular_heartbeat_detection true) plus integrated digital stethoscope, clinically validated (ANSI/AAMI/ISO 81060-2). US product page shows 'Coming soon' with no USD MSRP, so priceUsd null. Release year not found. Source URL switched to the canonical US product page.

products.name: QardioArm A100
products.priceNote: MSRP per MedGrade device listing; ~$99–100 across Best Buy / Newegg
products.provenance: Price $99.95 (~$100 at Best Buy) and specs confirmed: cuff 8.7–14.6 in (22–37 cm, standard arms only), unlimited app memory (no on-device count → null), Bluetooth, irregular-heartbeat detection, clinically validated. Corroboration URL changed from a dead Newegg listing to a live Best Buy product page. User profiles not stated; null. Release year not found.

products.name: Beurer BM67
products.priceNote: Current US retail price (Walmart); no official MSRP published by Beurer North America
products.provenance: Cuff 8.7–17.3 in (22–44 cm universal) confirmed via the Beurer USA instruction manual (dated 2018-02-06). 4 users × 30 readings each on-device (unlimited via Beurer HealthCoach app), Bluetooth, arrhythmia/irregular-heartbeat detection, ESH/International Protocol validated. CORRECTED price: draft $68.12 refreshed to $52.39, the current listed US retail at Walmart; no official Beurer NA MSRP published. Release year 2018 inferred from manual date.

products.name: A&D Medical UA-651BLE
products.provenance: MSRP $69.99 confirmed from the A&D manufacturer site (medical.andonline.com). Cuff 8.6–16.5 in (22–42 cm wide-range), 30 on-device readings, single-user on-device, Bluetooth to A&D Connect / MyVitals app, irregular-heartbeat (AFib) detection confirmed via the official Amazon title. Clinically validated (ISO 81060-2:2018, on the Validated Device Listing, FDA cleared). Source URL switched from Amazon to the manufacturer product page. Release year not found.

products.name: Greater Goods Bluetooth Blood Pressure Monitor
products.priceNote: MSRP per Greater Goods official store (shop.greatergoods.com); often discounted at Walmart
products.provenance: Specs confirmed from the Greater Goods official store: model 0604, $64.99 MSRP, cuff 8.7–16.5 in (22–42 cm), 120 on-device readings for 2 users, Bluetooth with Balance Health app (iOS/Android), irregular-heartbeat detection, FDA cleared. 2026 Wirecutter Top Pick (five-time pick). Release year not stated.

products.name: iHealth Track KN-550BT
products.priceNote: Manufacturer price per iHealth Labs (~$39.99); Amazon ~$42.95
products.provenance: CORRECTED THREE FIELDS. (1) irregular_heartbeat_detection false→true: MedGrade review and iHealth specs both confirm 'a standard IHB (irregular heartbeat) detector' (not AFib-specific). (2) cuff_range_in 8.66–16.5 in→8.6–18.9 in: iHealth's own spec sheet and MedGrade list a wide-range cuff of 22–48 cm (8.6–18.9 in). (3) priceUsd 59.99→39.99: iHealth Labs manufacturer price ~$39.99 (Amazon ~$42.95). 99 on-device readings, single user, Bluetooth with iHealth MyVitals app. FDA 510(k) cleared (K160014, 2016) supports release year 2016; clinically validated (ESH-IP2 / ISO 81060-2). Source URL switched from a 404-prone product slug to the live MedGrade review.

products.name: Welch Allyn Home 1700 Series
products.priceNote: Listed price via Hillrom/Welch Allyn channel; medical retailers range $119.99–$162.98
products.provenance: Model H-BP100SBP, Bluetooth 4.0, SureBP technology (measures on inflation in ~20 sec, 97% capture), irregular-heartbeat indicator, motion indicator confirmed from Hillrom. Standard D-ring cuff 22–42 cm (8.7–16.5 in). Listed on ValidateBP confirming clinical validation. On-device memory and user profiles not stated; null. Price $119.99 per Hillrom/Welch Allyn channel; Vitality Medical/PartsSource list up to $162.98. Release year not found.

products.name: Omron Complete BP7900
products.priceNote: MSRP $163.99 per Omron Healthcare official product page, which lists "MSRP $ 163.99"
products.provenance: The official Omron Healthcare product page confirms the exact model (Model number BP7900, UPC 073796267902, "Complete Wireless Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor + EKG"): MSRP "$ 163.99", "Memory per user: 90" (also "store up 90 blood pressure measurements on the device"), wide-range D-ring cuff "9\" to 17\"", Bluetooth via OMRON Connect, single-user on-device ("Two-user mode: No"), and it is described as "a clinically validated blood pressure monitor." irregular_heartbeat_detection is set true because the built-in single-lead EKG detects atrial fibrillation and the spec table lists an "Irregular heartbeat indicator (in app)". BV Medical (retailer, dated 2023-03-23) corroborates the model identity, the 9–17 in D-ring cuff, Bluetooth/OMRON Connect, clinical validation, and AFib/irregular-heartbeat detection via the EKG; neither page states a product release year, so releaseDate and release are null.

products.name: Withings BPM Vision
products.priceNote: MSRP US$179.95 per the Withings US official product page (withings.com/us/en/bpm-vision, "US$ 179.95"); independently corroborated at "$179.95" by The Gadgeteer's dated review (2025-05-22).
products.provenance: Fetched the official Withings US product page, which confirms the exact model "BPM Vision" Smart Blood Pressure Monitor at US$179.95: an upper-arm device with an 8.7–16.5 in (22–42 cm) standard FlexiFit cuff, up to 8 users, up to 16 on-device measurements between syncs, automatic Wi-Fi/Bluetooth sync via the Withings app, and FDA clearance with ISO 81060-2:2018+A1:2020 clinical validation (91-subject trial). The Gadgeteer's dated hands-on review (2025-05-22) independently confirms the identical model and the $179.95 price, and notes the device measures only systolic/diastolic/heart rate with ECG contacts present but "implemented in the future" — so no irregular-heartbeat detection is currently claimed (left null). No explicit release date is stated on either fetched page, so releaseDate and the release spec are null.

products.name: A&D Medical UA-767F
products.priceNote: Manufacturer product page (medical.andonline.com) lists the Multi User (UA-767F / UA-767FAC) variant price range as "$69.99 – $79.99"; $69.99 is the base UA-767F (batteries only), while $79.99 corresponds to the UA-767FAC with AC adapter.
products.provenance: Both the A&D manufacturer product page and the official Amazon listing confirm the exact model UA-767F (Amazon "Model Number UA-767F"; the manufacturer page explicitly distinguishes the UA-767F batteries-only unit from the UA-767FAC that adds an AC adapter). Manufacturer specifications verified verbatim: oscillometric upper-arm monitor, 8.6–16.5 in (22–42 cm) wide-range cuff, 60 on-device readings per user for up to 4 users, Irregular Heartbeat (IHB) detection, and clinical validation (ISO 81060-2:2013, listed on the Validated Device Listing); the UA-767F has no Bluetooth (the A&D Heart Track app only manually logs readings, corroborated by an Amazon reviewer noting it "doesn't pretend to have Bluetooth connectivity"), so bluetooth_app=false. Price $69.99 is the base UA-767F figure within the manufacturer's stated "$69.99 – $79.99" variant range, and no release year appears on either page.

products.name: Omron 7 Series Wrist BP6350
products.priceNote: MSRP $96.99 per the official OMRON Healthcare product page ("MSRP $ 96.99"). Retail is lower — MedGrade lists ~$66.99 at CVS.
products.provenance: The official OMRON Healthcare page confirms the exact model (Model number BP6350, UPC 073796266356, "7 Series Wireless Wrist Blood Pressure Monitor") and states MSRP $96.99, a wrist cuff fitting 5.3"–8.5" wrists, 90-reading on-device memory for one user, two-user mode "No" (→ user_profiles 1), Bluetooth via the OMRON Connect app, and Irregular Heartbeat Detection "Yes". MedGrade's dated clinical review corroborates the same model (Model: BP6350), the 90-reading/single-user memory, the 5.3 to 8.5 inch cuff, Bluetooth, and adds that the device is FDA 510(k) cleared and validated under the ANSI/AAMI/ISO 81060-2 protocol (→ clinically_validated true); it also lists a lower retail figure (~$66.99 at CVS). No release year is stated on either fetched page, so releaseDate and release are null.

products.name: Omron Silver BP5250
products.priceNote: Consumer Reports lists the "Omron Silver BP5250 (Amazon)" at $53.00 (Shop 1 Retailer); the linked Amazon ASIN B0DDZP9R7T showed "No featured offers available" at access time and is in fact the BP5255, so the $53.00 CR figure is the only sourced price.
products.provenance: AccessGUDID (FDA UDI record, labeler Omron Healthcare, Inc.) confirms the exact model — Brand "Omron Silver Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor", Version/Model "BP5250", Catalog "BP5250" — and states verbatim "80 reading memory storage" with "Bluetooth connectivity" for an automatic upper-arm sphygmomanometer (FDA K133383). Consumer Reports' model-specific "Omron Silver BP5250 (Amazon)" page corroborates a one-size 9–17 in cuff, an irregular-heartbeat detector (Yes), single-user storage (Multiple user memories: No → user_profiles 1), Bluetooth sync to the Omron Connect app, and lists the price at $53.00. The Amazon ASIN B0DDZP9R7T is a different model (BP5255, 30 readings/user), so it was not used for BP5250 specs; clinical validation and a release year were not stated verbatim on the fetched authoritative pages, so both are null.

products.name: iHealth Clear BPM1
products.priceNote: Consumer Reports' iHealth Clear BPM1 page lists this model at $100.00 (its Price & Shop model price); iHealth publishes no current official MSRP for this legacy product.
products.provenance: The official iHealth Labs support page confirms this exact model — "Clear Blood Pressure Monitor (BPM1)" by iHealth Labs Inc — establishing manufacturer identity (the ManualsLib "iHealth Clear BPM1" quick-start and Medical Mega listing, item BPM1 / UPC 856362005050, further corroborate it is the Clear BPM1 and not a sibling model). Consumer Reports' iHealth Clear BPM1 review supplied the verbatim specs used: an upper-arm ("Arm Monitors") type, included cuff "8.6 - 16.5 in.", "Irregular heartbeat detector: Yes", wireless download to the iHealth MyVitals app, and the model price "$100.00". Connectivity is Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) to the MyVitals app rather than Bluetooth, so bluetooth_app=true reflects app connectivity (verbatim on CR), while on-device memory count, exact user-profile number, an explicit clinical-validation statement, and release year were not stated verbatim on the fetched cited pages and are left null.
